app_info.subtitle: Send and analyse email
app_info.description: MisarMail lets users send transactional email, build and run multi-step campaigns and automations, manage contacts, segments and templates, A/B test, warm up sending domains and audit deliverability — from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can create, update, send, schedule or otherwise change MisarMail state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches the hosted MisarMail API over the network, so results depend on live account state outside this conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, revoke or irreversibly overwrite anything; any change it makes can be undone by a subsequent call.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves or computes data to return to the user; it does not change MisarMail records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on state local to the request.
